summary: The prompt file is the content artifact, its sidecar is the review artifact, and the usage projection is visible operational evidence at the same reading surface.

items.text: Use Sidecar Metadata for `<prompt>.meta.json`: bind review status and findings to the reviewed content fingerprint so a prompt edit visibly invalidates stale approval.
Use Compute Investment as a Quality Signal for the shared figure: invisible runtime work becomes legible when usage is rendered as metadata beside the artifact it qualifies.
Use Wiki as Cognitive Interface to place source text, review state and runtime evidence at the prompt rather than scattering them across specialist consoles.
Use Decision-making Above the Code Line to let operators judge rollout and reachability from system evidence, not from isolated code inspection.

Agent Studio reference implementation, in progress: `prompts/runtime/*.md` and `RuntimePromptService` establish the file registry and single loader; the target line adds a call ledger, per-content-version counts and review sidecars at that prompt surface.
Bind the exact prompt content version to TaskId and RunId so an execution trace can reconstruct instructions without elevating a provider chat transcript to the system of record.
See Prompt Enrichment Preprocessing for the related use case or counterpoint: Before execution, classify a generic request and visibly attach only the house context needed for that kind of work.
See Spec-Driven Development for the related use case or counterpoint: The spec is the source of truth, not the code.
